title: Chevening UK Government Scholarship
eligibility: Professionals with at least 2 years of work experience from Chevening-eligible countries
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition, monthly stipend, flights, visa fees)
qualification: Undergraduate degree that enables entry into a UK postgraduate program
description: Chevening offers fully-funded master's degrees in the UK for outstanding future leaders to undertake any eligible one-year master's degree at any UK university.

title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science or related technical field
qualification: Enrolled in a full-time degree program with experience in C++, Java, Python, or Go
description: Work on complex technical problems, build large-scale software systems, and collaborate with world-class engineers across Google's core product areas.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
eligibility: Open globally to developers with strong JavaScript, TypeScript, and HTML/CSS fundamentals
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
description: Join the web team at Canonical to build and maintain responsive user interfaces for Ubuntu and Canonical web applications globally.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
eligibility: Graduate students, young professionals, and artists from over 160 eligible countries
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition, living allowance, health insurance, travel)
qualification: Bachelor's degree or equivalent academic record
description: Enables graduate students, young professionals, and artists from abroad to study and conduct research in the United States at leading universities.

title: Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in an accredited educational institution globally
salary: Up to $100,000 USD + Microsoft Azure Credits & Mentorship
qualification: High School, Undergraduate, or Graduate Students
description: Microsoft Imagine Cup is a global competition for student developers to build innovative solutions using AI and cloud technology to address real-world challenges.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide interested in fundamental computer science principles
description: An entry-level course taught by David J. Malan that teaches students how to think algorithmically and solve problems efficiently using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
